tools.name: autoposter_get_post_status

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, reconnection, and display-metadata changes.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "get_profile" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Return the profile represented by this request's authenticated credentials. The opaque id is unique within this app and remains unchanged across token refresh, …

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: autoposter_list_accounts, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_list_posts, autoposter_list_media · Private data: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_list_media, get_profile · Public sink: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_delete_post · Destructive: autoposter_get_rules, autoposter_delete_post.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: autoposter_list_accounts, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_list_posts, autoposter_list_media · Private data: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_list_media, get_profile · Public sink: autoposter_upload_media, autoposter_get_media_upload_url, autoposter_draft_post, autoposter_schedule_post, autoposter_publish_draft, autoposter_get_post_status, autoposter_get_post, autoposter_delete_post · Destructive: autoposter_get_rules, autoposter_delete_post

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
